One workspace. Every device.

Your work happens everywhere. Your software should too.

Field-service professionals constantly switch between phone, tablet, desktop, paper notes, and messaging apps. SiteMate brings those workflows together.

In the field

Capture jobs, photos, notes, expenses, and customer information from your phone.

At the desk

Manage customers, jobs, quotes, invoices, and business activity from your Mac.

On the move

Use your Apple Watch for quick job actions without pulling out your phone.

Everything about your business, in one view.

Work even when the signal doesn't.

SiteMate is designed with field work in mind. Important information can remain available when connectivity is limited, and synchronize automatically once you're back online.

Built as a modern cross-platform system.

SiteMate is being built as a learning-driven, production-minded project exploring modern cross-platform development, native mobile development, backend engineering, databases, APIs, offline-first architecture, and CI/CD.
